market.state: UPTREND — index at highs, and the Nasdaq just reclaimed its 50-DMA
market.advice: Into the open the index is as healthy as it has looked all quarter: SPY is 771.31, sitting flat ON its 52-week high, above its 50-DMA at 746.17, up 4.0% on the week and 3.5% on the month. VIX is 15.9 and falling, there are ZERO distribution days on the board, and a follow-through day has printed. The Dow closed at a record on Mideast-deal optimism. The change worth acting on since Monday is in the Nasdaq: QQQ is 715.55 and has now reclaimed its 50-DMA, after spending the last two sessions below it. That was the one broken piece of an otherwise healthy tape, and it just healed. Of the 440 names that returned clean data this pass, 140 rate STRONG BUY, and the leadership is still outside big-cap tech — banks, insurers, aerospace, rails, industrial machinery, storage and data-centre REITs, staples and refiners. But the semiconductor complex is repairing at the top: NVDA has reclaimed both its 50-DMA (205.89) and 200-DMA (193.61), sits 5.5% from its high with RSI 65 at 17.3x forward earnings, and TradingView flipped it to STRONG BUY with 17 buy signals and zero sells — the strongest card in the whole ratings file. DELL is up 87% on revenue with AI server demand, ANET is growing 37%, and DLR is renting the buildout at 30% revenue growth. That is NOT a green light on the sector. AMAT is still 28% off its high, MU 30%, LRCX 31%, NXPI 31%, INTC 31%, WDC 42%, AMD 18% with TradingView on SELL, and TSM 13% down. Buy the repair one ticker at a time. Three cautions. First, breadth is 62% above the 50-DMA — moderate, not broad — and this leaderboard is again heavy with financials and REITs, which is one macro bet on rates and credit wearing a dozen tickers; size that group as a single position. Second, an earnings wall lands inside 48 hours: HWM, MET, RL, LNG, OXY, KDP, VTRS, TAP and CEG report TODAY, and ABNB, AFL, RGA, MNST, TTD and PPL report TOMORROW, with LQDA on the 12th and CSCO on the 13th — anything on that list is a WATCH here, not a buy, however good the chart looks. Third, the Iran story is carrying this tape and it is one headline deep: Iran-Oman talks are live, Iran has publicly warned Gulf states, Houthis hit a Saudi tanker and Gulf shipping traffic is down. A failed round gaps energy up and everything else down together, and payrolls are still ahead. Trade the un-extended leaders, respect the stops, and do not chase RSI 85+ names — RTX is at 88.
market.sizing: Normal size on the un-extended financial, industrial, REIT and staples leaders with earnings 20+ days out. Half size or wait on anything reporting inside 48 hours (HWM today, ABNB tomorrow) and on LQDA/CSCO next week. Cap combined banks + insurers + REITs as ONE macro position, not twelve. On semis and AI hardware, NVDA and DELL only for now — no new money into AMD, MU, LRCX, AMAT, INTC, WDC or TSM until a base actually forms; a 30% drawdown is not a setup. Note the built-in hedge: PSX gains on a failed Iran round, LUV gains on a successful one.
